meaning: The complete algorithm/ownership/funding-partition shape is accepted for independently deriving new literal costs. This is not data binding, numeric/source-fit/native/resource/combined-proof or execution admission.
reviewed_properties: One genuine nonrecursive origin: new fields/slices/materialization remain declaration-only priced, with no arbitrary caller Fund/Plan/profile or retry/reset API.

Captured-state map/result separation and paid raw-storage owner drop order are preserved. Local staging dies before terminal release; actual result acquire precedes Control mutation; Result retains State without a reverse State-to-result edge.

The variable quote executes six checked terms and reserves Q(R) before NativeSession/query locals. A monotone full-prefix walk needs at most R-1 extra full helpers; at most two endpoint partials; two selected searches use at most2*bit_width(R) bodies. R0 has no append/search.

Every old callee amount is an exact derived vector sum, moved to protected queryCallee_ in the same origin. Later checks cannot spend that slice; branchless actual transfer immediately precedes each guaranteed old invocation. A pre-entry rejection leaves that reservation unused/terminal, not actual/refunded.
The three ADR0089 tariffs remain1+6R,4096,1024+N*(8+16C), with one straight no-retry chain, exact successful cumulative comparison and no second inherited debit.

Old query compositions match the accepted190-row/13-template catalogue. Early scalar refusals preserve order; zero-fraction endpoints use one compiled lookup. Prefix state is not contaminated by partial endpoints, and native floor casts require finite nonnegative values below2^63.

Actual append bool/double results and old return statuses are distinguished from source-derived path vectors and unavailable internal visits. Query not-entered placeholders never become known old statuses. Reconciliation checks all public Window fields/control ownership, not hidden cache/intermediate bytes.

Snapshot fields including fexcept_t are value-initialized before possible getter failure. Session lifecycle fields are initialized before every early return. Native SDK restores represented flags/six MXCSR bits/errno before actual resolve; no pre-query target is applied after the actual call.

Private NativeBinding has no definition. Nonzero fact digests are completeness checks only; compiler/control/getter comparisons do not claim loaded-image or true-interval validation. All declared native/codegen/unrepresented-state obligations remain held.
mandatory_census_and_proof_obligations: Re-derive all363 Sites and every affected first-write/copy/caller/root/role/cleanup envelope. Preserving234 ordinal names does not preserve old prices: Raw/LegacyRaw/LegacyReadout/State/Control/App sizes and copies changed.

Common::requested and PreparedAttempt::limits each perform two MusicalAudioLimits DMI writes/implicit construction before their first inner pay. An already-entered caller partition must sponsor these on every reached path, including early cancellation/refusal.
ArmResult and TakeResult must sponsor four nested ChannelResult status DMI writes/implicit construction before WorkerLegacyResult constructor bodies; later zero/copy actions remain separate.

Each FundedOwner/WorkerArtifacts/NativeSession constructor pre-body pointer/member work and each after-physical-return destruction tail needs its real caller/destructor sponsor, not a later body debit.

Include all fixed10-cell vector/add/sum/record loops,17*32 maximum fact/digest loops, every native read/restore/postcheck/reject/destructor branch and the extra queryCallee_ initial/split/commit/terminal-retire work. No old ceiling-as-actual or fourth tariff.

Live Result and Retained/Reader are exclusive, but after taking/destroying Result while Control remains, retainCurrentAfterTerminal can issue Retained/Reader later in the same request. The finite root/control/legacy schedule and combined proof must cover that permitted sequential case, not assume permanently disjoint issuance.

Restoration is conditional on the represented native checks succeeding: after rejection accepted_ is false, destructor can return from check without calling restoreStatus. No successful restoration on a qualification/SDK failure is inferred. Qualified native facts must close successful admitted behavior; failed attempts retain their named outcome and unused held callee amount.

Complete native/module/dispatch/control/new-handler/codegen/observer-effects and relevant x87-state arguments, actual owner ingress/allocator/ABI/stack/staging/result/retained overlap, literal binding and independent combined R4 proof must precede execution or production integration.

If explicit restore fails its initial check while restoring_ stays true, the destructor can attempt that check again. Include both funded attempts; this path can make zero physical restoreStatus calls. After the physical restore has run, restoring_ is false even if postverification rejects.
